description: VRN Haltestellen is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobilithek. Die Haltestellen des Verkehrsverbundes werden im Datenbanksystem DIVA gepflegt und fortlaufend aktualisiert. Der Zugriff auf die aktuellen Daten kann über die offene TRIAS-Schnittstelle erfolgen. In unregelmäßigen Abständen (mindestens zweimal jährlich zum Fahrplanwechsel) veröffentlichen wir hier einen Export aus unseren DIVA-Datenbankbeständen als ArcGIS-Feature-Service. Coverage: Mobilithek. The portal files it under the publisher Mobilithek. Its tags are 16dkvs1004, bahnhöfe, bushaltestellen, diva, haltestellen. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
